run_RBGTTracker_track: run the RBGTTracker track method to start a background thread that tracks 3D body poses from an image handle
run_RBGTTracker_output: run the RBGTTracker output method to retrieve a thread-safe deep copy of the tracked body pose results list
run_subThreadTracker_run: run the subThreadTracker run method to iterate over frames executing measured tracking cycles and collecting pose outputs
review_subThreadTracker_CalculatePoseRes: review the subThreadTracker CalculatePoseResults method to compute translation error, rotation error, and tracking loss against ground truth poses
review_subThreadTracker_ExecuteMeasuredT: review the subThreadTracker ExecuteMeasuredTrackingCycle method to perform correspondence calculation and pose update iterations for tracking
